rewards: Access to a bank on Ape Atoll
Ability to wield the Heavy Ballista
Access to Maniacal Monkey hunting area

st.t: Talk to King Narnode Shareen in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
s: I'll help you look for Glough.

st.t: Climb the ladder into Glough's house, just south-east of the Grand Tree, then climb the tree on the other side of the house to the next floor. Long-press the tree branch there and choose Investigate.
Go talk to Anita in her house in the far north-west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold, up the most north-western staircase.
s: He might be in trouble, I could help.

st.t: Return to Glough's house and climb the tree to the 2nd floor, then climb the northern branch to the 3rd floor.
Investigate the nearby statue and turn it.
Search the fire remains.
Search the crates.
Use a pestle and mortar on a lemon
Use the notes on the candles.
Use a pestle and mortar on some grapes.
Use the brush on the note.
Read the note.
Use the translation book on the scrawled note. If you don't have the book, talk to King Narnode for another, then use it on the note.
Go talk to Narnode.
Go talk to Anita in the west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
Return to Narnode with the translation.
Talk to Auguste on Entrana. You can take the hot air balloon there from south of the Grand Tree with a log, or travel from Port Sarim.
i: No combat items to travel to Entrana

st.t: Return to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree.

i: No combat items to travel to Entrana

st.t: Wear your ninja greegree and M'speak amulet, then talk to Garkor on the eastern side of Ape Atoll. If you have fairy rings, CLR takes you to the island.
Talk to Awowogei.
s: I'm here to discuss military strategies.

st.t: Talk to Garkor again.
Talk to a monkey archer on the hill on the west of Ape Atoll. If you still need a monkey talisman, buy one for 1000 coins at Tutab's Magical Market, the magic shop on Ape Atoll.

Find the trapdoor hidden under jungle grass at the foot of a palm tree, just north-west of the bamboo gate. Keep one inventory space free: your greegree comes off as you enter and drops to the ground if your inventory is full. Enter the trapdoor.

Take the agility route: head south then east from the entrance. On dodgy ground, walk only on the flat tiles and avoid the ones with an X pattern. Protect from Melee if you fall. The right way differs per player: whenever the game says "Something about this route feels wrong.", "Something about this tunnel feels wrong." or "Something in the tunnel attacks you. Maybe this is the wrong route.", turn back and take another way. The Solution button shows a map of the dungeon.

If you fall, find the rope back up. Depending on where you land, go up the rope to the west (use Protect from Melee), to the south east (use Protect from Ranged) or to the north west (use Protect from Melee).
Long-press the chest in the cavern to the east and choose Unlock, then search it to get a bronze key.
Make your way north then through the bronze door.
Traverse the next section of the dungeon. PROTECT FROM MISSILE if you fall.
Continue through the dungeon to the west and south-west. PROTECT FROM MELEE if you fall. Near the end the path splits into a western and an eastern route; remember which one you take.

After the last obstacle, before you step onto the final dodgy ground, investigate the wall that faces the route you did NOT take (the western wall if you came the eastern way, the eastern wall if you came the western way). This opens a shortcut back to the entrance.
Prepare to fight Kruk, then enter the hole to the south. If you're back near the entrance, enter the shortcut there first.
Kill Kruk. He can be flinched on a corner in the room by keeping him on a north east tile to you.
Search Kruk's Corpse.
Leave the dungeon up the rope to the west.
Enter the dungeon in south Ape Atoll.

Go through the long maze to Zooknock in the north east of the dungeon. Wearing a greegree stops the monkeys and spiders attacking you. From the ladder go east, north, west, north, east, south, east, then north. Go west along the whole dungeon, then south, east, south, west, south, east, south, and west to the far west side. Go north all the way, then east all the way. Talk to Zooknock.
Talk to Awowogei as Kruk.
Talk to Garkor on Ape Atoll.
Enter the Troll Stronghold, ready to fight Kob.
From the Troll Stronghold's entrance, go south-west into the room with Kob. Turn on Protect from Melee and talk to him, ready to fight.
s: I know about your deal with the monkeys.
You won't be around to crush anyone when I'm done with you.

st.t: Fight Kob. He can be safespotted from the doorway.

Talk to Keef in Gu'Tanoth, past all the bridges. With 71 Agility you can use the agility shortcut next to him. Otherwise bring 20 coins to pass the bridges. Be prepared to fight him and pray Protect from Melee.
s: I know about your deal with the monkeys.
I offer to spare your life.

st.t: Fight Keef. He can be safespotted.
Talk to Garkor on Ape Atoll.

Wearing your Kruk greegree, find Assistant Le Smith. He's in one of four high places in Marim: 1) On the bridge joining the two watchtowers of the main gate. 2) On the top floor, up two ladders, of the broken building next to the monkey child's garden. 3) On the top floor of the jail: climb the ladder by Solihib's Food Stall, walk north, and climb the ladder at the back of the room with the bamboo bed. 4) On the top floor of the building west of the magic stall: climb the ladder at the south end of the temple, then the ladder in that building's north-west corner, and run all the way south-west.
Talk to Assistant Le Smith.
s: I was going to ask you the same question.
Awowogei has already informed me about the battleships.

st.t: Talk to Garkor.
Talk to the monkey guard on the north west of Ape Atoll.
s: I would like to go back to the construction platform.

st.t: Navigate through the platform, avoiding the monkey guards, to the east side and climb the ladder there.
Make your way south then west, and go down the ladder there.
Follow the path around and search the crates there for 6 satchels. There are no monkeys here to avoid.
Climb back up the ladder.
Make your way east then north, and go down the ladder there.
Navigate through the platform, avoiding the monkey guards, back to the first ladder you passed, on the north wall, and climb it.
Make your way east then south and go down the ladder there. Avoid the monkey on the way.
Fill your satchels with gunpowder from the barrel to the north. If a guard catches you from now on, your satchels are soaked: come back here and refill them. Charges you have already placed stay put.
Go back up the ladder to the first floor.
Use a satchel on the weakened floorboards just south of the ladder.
Go down the ladder to the north west.
Place a satchel on the support to the south.
Go to the east side and climb the ladder there.
Make your way to the west across the vine, then north then east to the end of the path. Place a satchel on the weakened floorboards there.
Return to the east side where you came from and go up to the 2nd floor.
Place a satchel on the gas cylinder to the south.
Make your way to the west then north and place a satchel on the gas cylinder there.
Go back to the bottom floor.
Go back towards the boat and place the final satchel on the support beams in the west fork near the entrance.
Leave the platform via the boat. DON'T teleport away. You can shortcut here by getting caught.
Return to Garkor on Ape Atoll.
Enter the trapdoor under some grass in the north west of Ape Atoll.
Your greegree came off as you entered. Wear the Kruk monkey greegree again, then climb across the monkey bars to the north.
Enter the passage to the north.
Walk through the big doors ahead, climb onto the stunted gorilla, then go down the stairs.
Fight the tortured gorillas. When you're done, be careful NOT to tap out of the cutscene or you'll need to do this again.
Dismount the gorilla on a holding area. If you didn't bring a chisel and hammer, search the crates nearby for them.
Climb back up the stairs, take off your greegree, then tamper with the device to the north.
Use a chisel on the charged onyx.
Use the onyx back on the device.
Investigate one of the incubation chambers in the room.
Return to Garkor.
Talk to Awowogei.
Talk to Garkor again.
Talk to King Narnode Shareen in the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Be prepared for fighting, and bring 2 combat styles.
Talk to Nieve south of the Grand Tree. Be prepared to fight with 2 combat styles.

Walk around the north-west part of the Gnome Stronghold with Nieve and kill the tortured gorillas that appear, 4 in all, until Nieve tells you to move on. Each must come from a different spot: a second kill at the same spot doesn't count. If you lose Nieve, you can get her again from the Grand Tree.
Enter the breach north west of the Grand Tree with Nieve.
Enter the cavern to the north east.
Talk to Glough in the north of the cavern. After, defeat the tortured and demonic gorillas.

Defeat Glough. He has 3 phases, changing rooms each time. You can safe spot the first 2 phases. Protect from Melee if you're next to him, or Protect from Magic if not in the third phase. The easiest way to do phase 3 is to attack him from 1 tile away, have Protect from Magic on, and step away a tile whenever he pulls you closer.
Talk to Zooknock to teleport to the Grand Tree.
Talk to Narnode to finish the madness!
